title: Timmy's Red Ball
text: Timmy has a bright red ball. He rolls the red ball on the soft green grass. The ball bounces high near a cozy bench. Timmy laughs with joy and catches his red ball.
sentences: Timmy has a bright red ball.
He rolls the red ball on the soft green grass.
The ball bounces high near a cozy bench.
Timmy laughs with joy and catches his red ball.

questions.question: What color is Timmy's ball?
questions.explanation: Timmy has a bright red ball that rolls on the grass.

questions.question: Where does the ball roll?
questions.explanation: Timmy rolls the ball on the soft green grass.

title: The Little Cat
text: A small fluffy cat sits on a soft blue mat. The cat drinks sweet warm milk from a white saucer. The cat purrs softly and closes its eyes for a happy afternoon nap.
sentences: A small fluffy cat sits on a soft blue mat.
The cat drinks sweet warm milk from a white saucer.
The cat purrs softly and closes its eyes for a happy afternoon nap.

questions.question: What is the cat sitting on?
questions.explanation: The small fluffy cat sits on a soft blue mat.

questions.question: What sound does the cat make when it is happy?
questions.explanation: Cats purr gently when they feel content and safe.

title: The Bright Yellow Star
text: High in the midnight sky, a little yellow star twinkles. It shines like a tiny sparkling diamond. The star smiles down on sleeping children, whispering sweet dreams.
sentences: High in the midnight sky, a little yellow star twinkles.
It shines like a tiny sparkling diamond.
The star smiles down on sleeping children, whispering sweet dreams.

questions.question: What shines high in the midnight sky?
questions.explanation: The bright yellow star twinkles in the sky.

title: The Busy Bee
text: A cheerful bee flies from flower to flower. It collects sweet nectar to make golden honey. Buzz buzz sings the busy bee as the sunny garden blooms.
sentences: A cheerful bee flies from flower to flower.
It collects sweet nectar to make golden honey.
Buzz buzz sings the busy bee as the sunny garden blooms.

questions.question: What does the busy bee make from nectar?
questions.explanation: Bees make delicious sweet honey in their hives.

title: Five Sweet Apples
text: Five sweet red apples hang upon a leafy tree. The wind blows gently and one apple falls down. Now four sweet apples remain on the tree, waiting for friends to share.
sentences: Five sweet red apples hang upon a leafy tree.
The wind blows gently and one apple falls down.
Now four sweet apples remain on the tree, waiting for friends to share.

questions.question: How many apples were on the tree at first?
questions.explanation: There were five sweet red apples on the tree.
